ctx.x: This is a jazz record book. It was edited by David Hall. Now, I believe that Charles Edward Smith and Ramsey both contributed to that.
Oh, okay. I just had the editor mixed up.

items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: I guess it was Fred Ramsey that interviewed me on tape about Bolden

ctx.x: And did you go to hear music with him?

Uh, no, but he was the one who brought, who bought most of the records that came into the house. Mm-hm. And, uh, uh, of course we had all the early jazz records, largely because of the fact that he knew the musicians himself, and, uh, and I came to know many of the musicians when I was very young. I remember, for example, some social function that went on in the house when I was very young, for which Papa Celestan's band was hired. And, uh, while I don't remember who the individual musicians were, my first…
Well, was your uncle hiring bands?
